caption: The drawing consists of six numbered sections arranged in two rows: five at the top and one larger section at the bottom. Each section contains a tilted grid of evenly spaced circles, some of which are filled in with color. In section 1, there is a faint empty grid. In section 2, the top left corner shows a cluster of circles outlined in black. In section 3, three groups of circles are filled in with black: two in the top half and one in the bottom half of the grid. In section 4, black-outlined circles are filled with color: blue in the upper left and green in the bottom left. Section 5 is similar to section 4, but with slightly more filled circles, again in blue and green. In section 6, the largest, most detailed section at the bottom, the grid contains a repeating pattern made up of circles filled with blue, green, and red colors: a top row of blue and white, a bottom row of green, and a large area of red-brown, with groups of green shapes in between. Each section is labeled with a small black numeral, and the lower right corner of the paper bears the handwritten name "Ray Crosswell." The background of the paper is an off-white color with faint marks and spots.
title: Technique Demonstration
